Join the Reflectiz Dream Team

Looking for an exceptional start-up spirit coupled with in-depth cybersecurity experience? You’ve found us. At Reflectiz, we use this combination to adapt to any new challenge, handle risks more effectively than any other, and make sure that we develop unique, spearhead security solutions to answer our clients needs.

Explore open positions

What’s it like at Reflectiz?

Here at Reflectiz, you can enjoy working to develop an exciting and industry-leading product, learning and growing your knowledge in the cybersecurity field, and most importantly – you’ll meet and work alongside some amazing people who have lots of fun together.

Our employees are just as important as our customers, and so we prioritize:

Flexible work

Our choice-first environment means we trust that our employees know how they work best. We’re happy with any hybrid office/home set-up, so you can choose the balance that works for you.

Welfare and social life

We believe that you will work well if you feel well. We have team-building sessions, interesting opportunities for professional development, and of course plenty of delicious happy hours!

A unique product

Our employees are excited about the work they do, which comes from having an interesting and inspiring product that is totally one of a kind.
